name: Video Downloader (yt-dlp)
description: Download a video, a whole playlist, or search-and-download with yt-dlp straight into a library folder, with live progress. yt-dlp installs itself automatically on first use — no setup needed. New files appear in your library after the next scan. (ffmpeg, already required by Free-WAN, is used to merge best-quality video+audio.)
author: Free-WAN

config.name: ytdlpPath
config.label: yt-dlp binary (optional)
config.help: Leave as 'yt-dlp' to auto-install and manage yt-dlp for you. Set a command or absolute path (e.g. C:/tools/yt-dlp.exe) only if you want to use your own copy.

config.name: cookiesPath
config.label: Cookies file (optional)
config.help: Path to a Netscape-format cookies.txt on the server. Unlocks sites that need a login, age check, or region cookie. Export with a 'cookies.txt' browser extension.

config.name: extraArgs
config.label: Extra yt-dlp flags (optional)
config.help: Appended to every download, e.g. --impersonate chrome (needs yt-dlp installed with curl-cffi) or --proxy socks5://host:port. Quotes group values with spaces.
